note: Byte-identical mirror of the engine file named above, taken at the pinned rev. The 18 HM-4 vectors are what hold this package's WebAuthn verifier to the engine's -- two ACCEPT cases so the refusals are not satisfied by a verifier that refuses everything, and one refusal per HM-4 step because the property the implementations must agree on is WHICH step refused, not that one did. The mirror lives beside the file rather than inside it because a header written INTO the JSON would change the bytes and the identity claim would be about a different object. tools/check-verify-mirror.py enforces both halves: this sidecar matches the mirrored bytes, and the mirrored bytes match the engine source. Do not edit either by hand; re-mirror at a pin bump.
